correctness.rationale: Exact hypoexponential survival yields p_n=A u^n-B v^n and rational PGF with numerator 1+r z. The complete infinite logarithmic coefficient sequence is (u^n+v^n+(-1)^(n-1)r^n)/n. Its nonnegativity is exactly r<=u; r>u forces negative sufficiently large even coefficients. Reduction to F_q(t) and the strict inequality -log q>2(1-q)/(1+q) make F strictly convex with zeros at t=1 and t=2, giving b>=2a for unequal rates. Equal Erlang rates give r>u by a>2tanh(a/2). The discrete Bilal specialization and unique-root asymptotic are explicitly proved. The supplied checker reproduced 3,122 symbolic, exact-rational and high-precision supporting assertions; numerical checks are not treated as infinite proofs. C risk: no independent expert confirmation.

value.rationale: The 2:1 boundary is a natural, complete classification of the additive infinite-divisibility property for a two-stage lifetime under operationally common integer-time binning. An observed count can or cannot be interpreted as a compound-Poisson cluster sum depending on a sharp relative stage-rate cutoff. The one-parameter discrete Bilal family is universally excluded whereas Poisson sampling of exactly the same continuous lifetime produces a geometric convolution; this is a motivated structural contrast rather than a relabeling. The asymptotic first negative coefficient quantifies why low-order positivity checks can miss failure near the slow-time-scale limit. Finite experiments and novelty alone are not used as value arguments.
